attchmntText: Soma Textiles & Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Soma Textiles and Industries Limited submitted the paper cutting of its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on 12th November 2026. The results were published in the Financial Express and Ekdin newspapers on the same date. The filing is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosures Requirements Regulations 2015. The document includes a Bengali language announcement regarding the company's Annual General Meeting scheduled for 2nd December 2026. The meeting will be held at the registered office in Kolkata from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM. The agenda includes the adoption of financial statements and the appointment of directors. The announcement provides details on the company's bank account information and contact numbers for investor queries. The text contains extensive Bengali script detailing the meeting logistics and statutory requirements. No specific financial figures are reported in the English portion of the submission.

attchmntText: Soma Textiles & Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Soma Textiles and Industries Limited submitted its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, approved by the Board on 11 November 2026. The company reported a net profit of 194 lakhs for the quarter, compared to a loss of 63 lakhs in the same period last year. Revenue from operations stood at 3273 lakhs. The statutory auditors, Pipara and Co, issued a limited review report with no material misstatements noted. The company underwent a change in promoter control, with Roadway Solutions India Infra Limited, Mr. Ameet Harjinder Gadhoke, and Mrs. Teja Ranade Gadhoke acquiring the stake from the previous promoters. New directors have been appointed to the Board. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.
